Setup includes scratch allocation/construction/module loading where encountered, after input upload. Eager graph preparation plus first solve, subsequent outer capture, first captured replay and warmed replay are reported separately. Same process, cached compilation, fixed global-then-block order; setup is not a cold-install comparison. No complete FEM speed claim. External occupancy required. Production dispatch unchanged.
